title: Official hot blog generic evidence admission
summary: Fixed a main-stream admission false negative where primary-confirmed official technical blogs from sources such as Google Research, Google DeepMind, and Hugging Face could be rejected as generic hot blog announcements when feed discovery only supplied a generic blog/interview evidence sentence.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "report:draft admits official technical hot blogs with generic feed evidence" tests/unit.test.js
node --test --test-name-pattern "report:draft admission scoring|report:draft admits official technical hot blogs" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Thin feed evidence should not erase a specific primary-confirmed official technical blog.
lessons.evidence: The new draft test failed before implementation because a Google Research URL with a specific technical title and generic feed evidence did not enter main_items; after the fix Google Research, DeepMind, and Hugging Face examples enter the main stream.
lessons.recommended_action: When hot-blog evidence is generic, fall back to source, URL, and title specificity only for trusted official technical blog surfaces.

lessons.lesson: The generic hot-blog filter still needs a negative fixture.
lessons.evidence: The same test keeps a generic title-only hot blog rejected with main_reject_reason=generic_hot_blog_announcement.
lessons.recommended_action: Do not widen the official technical blog exemption without retaining a generic announcement rejection case.

suggestions.issue: Official technical blog candidates can still arrive with generic feed evidence.
suggestions.evidence: This iteration added a safe title/source/URL fallback for primary-confirmed official technical blogs, but the stronger fix is to extract article-specific evidence during discovery.
suggestions.suggestion: Improve content discovery extraction so official blog candidates carry article-specific evidence instead of relying on title and URL fallback.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future drafts can rank and summarize official technical blogs from source evidence rather than from title/URL heuristics.
suggestions.promotion_path: Open a follow-up project_iteration with red tests for official blog evidence extraction.

followups.action: Run a real dated non-publish draft after this lands and inspect whether official research/engineering blog candidates are selected as stories without needing AI repair.
